# Clivik Digital Solutions

> WhatsApp lead automation, 30-Day Follow-Up Autopilot, customer review automation, and RTO reduction for local and D2C businesses.

## About
Clivik Digital Solutions is an AI automation agency based in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India. Founded by Arjit Gour, Clivik helps local and lead-driven businesses capture, qualify, follow up with, and convert customers using automated WhatsApp AI agents, Google review automation, and COD/RTO confirmation systems.

## Core Services
- WhatsApp Lead Qualification: 24/7 automated qualification of inbound inquiries in under 10 seconds that filters serious buyers and schedules appointments without human delay.
- 30-Day WhatsApp Follow-Up Autopilot: Multi-step conversational follow-ups on WhatsApp (Day 1, 3, 7, 14, 30) that re-engage prospects who did not buy on first contact.
- WhatsApp Marketing: Targeted broadcast campaigns, customer retention sequences, and promotional messaging with high open and response rates.
- Customer Review Automation: Automated post-service review collection sent via WhatsApp directing satisfied clients to Google Maps profiles to build local SEO authority.
- COD & RTO Confirmation: Instant WhatsApp address verification and pre-dispatch confirmation to reduce return-to-origin rates for e-commerce.
- Website Add-On: Fast, custom-built websites as an optional add-on to WhatsApp automation systems.

## Target Customers
Local businesses and lead-driven enterprises, including:
- Healthcare & Dental Clinics
- Restaurants, Cafes & Dining Outlets
- Gyms & Fitness Centers
- Real Estate Consultants & Property Firms
- Local Retail Stores & Professional Service Providers
